summary: Cirrus Logic filed an 8-K regarding a third amended and restated credit agreement with Wells Fargo Bank, providing a $350M senior secured revolving credit facility maturing May 4, 2031. The facility is secured by substantially all assets and guaranteed by material domestic subsidiaries, with interest based on Base Rate or Term SOFR plus margins tied to leverage ratio. This is a routine refinancing of existing credit lines, not a special situation requiring a special-situations classification.
